svg.title: Molecule of the day: Lidocaine
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Lidocaine while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as 0.89.
svg.text: MW 234.3 · cLogP 2.58 · TPSA 32.3 · HBD 1 · HBA 2 · RotB 5
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
